name: Public code repository commit history and leaked secret scanning
topic: Public code repository commit history and leaked secret scanning
description: Public code repository commit history and leaked secret scanning -- a easy-tier osint challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Public code repository commit history and leaked secret scanning"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is a hex-encoded XOR cipher (4-byte repeating key). Brute-force or crib-drag with the known flag prefix.
